examples.title: The way of heaven and the drawn bow: a concordance, not a confirmation
examples.label: an AI reading of a law proved on the World model; classification and reading unreviewed by any person
examples.markdown:
**The passage.** 《老子》第七十七章, as stored: 「天之道，其犹张弓与？高者抑之，下者举之；有馀者损之，不足者补之。天之道，损有馀而补不足。」 In English (this page's translation, AI-made): "The way of heaven, is it not like drawing a bow? The high it presses down, the low it lifts; from what has too much it takes, to what has too little it adds. The way of heaven takes from what has too much and makes up what has too little."

**The law set beside it.** Proved on the World model, with no axiom: with balance at the condition, "the joint exchange departs from evenness by at most the gap to `m` on each side exactly where the next level lies between `m` and the present one: the bound is exactly no overshoot; within it, opposing, the level settles at `m`; beyond it an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever" ([02](chapters/02-MAP.md#r-two-sided-regulation-and-late-reading)). One side is not regulation: a witness meets the premise of restoration and stays above `m` ([record](results/records/two-sided-regulation-and-late-reading.md)). Regulation "restates deadbeat control and requisite variety" ([08 §8](chapters/08-METHOD.md#beyond-the-table)).

**What the concordance records** [AI reading, D54]. The map of Chinese sources found no law for a level held from both sides; these laws "are the formal statements it proposed; reading the passages as them is the AI's" (the record). The passage is entered as *scoping*, not *agreement*: lowering the high and raising the low is "the property of a regulating coupling", not a law of the whole unfolding, and the text's attribution of it to the way of heaven the theory does not adopt ([the entry](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/ro-relational-sources/passages.json), `lao-77-tian-zhi-dao`). The chapter goes on 「人之道则不然」, and 06 lists the way of people, taking from those without enough to serve those with too much, as a response within the tradition to contest and rank ([06 §六](chapters/06-CLASSICAL-TEXTS.md#four-layers)).

**What it does not show.** Agreement is not confirmation: the law holds without the text and does not exhaust its meaning; scoping is not denial ([06](chapters/06-CLASSICAL-TEXTS.md#three-relations)). The record does not show "that a given system regulates a level" or "that holding a level is good", so the concordance gives no advice for practice. No person has read the classification or the reading ([06](chapters/06-CLASSICAL-TEXTS.md#open)). That the core's common relations are indispensable across all wisdom is an open target ([03](chapters/03-KNOWING.md#r-wisdom-root)).

**What a scholar can do.** Judge whether *scoping* is the right class and the attribution rightly set aside, and whether passages were chosen to fit the theory ([C-31](review/CLASSICAL-TEXTS.md#c-31), question 74).

examples.title: T2 in the flour beetle: a wording that failed, and a tie by construction
examples.label: a thesis, conjectured: frozen tests, one of which failed a former wording
examples.markdown:
**The claim.** Thesis T2: "the state of a renewable condition under a draw is its level, its recent giving and one lag, its place named before the data" ([02](chapters/02-MAP.md#t2)). It is worded so that it can fail. Among what it forbids: "a fourth variable from the level's own history removing a tenth of the residual variance in the median series".

**In fish stocks.** Of four frozen tests, MQ4 failed its whole-state verdict, MQ5 passed and MQ7 missed its frozen bound; UE32 found T2's numbers better than the field's fitted embedding, both behind persistence in most stocks: "sufficiency against it at these lengths, not the lag's place or T2's law" ([08 §9](chapters/08-METHOD.md#theses)).

**In the flour beetle.** T2 then said the three numbers fix the next giving "as far as anything measured does". A frozen test, UE31b, read the laboratory cultures of the flour beetle, where a stage before recruitment is counted; it ran on 6 November 2026 ([result](../../experiments/state-named-in-advance/README.md#ue31bs-result)). "The pupae counted now are the next recruits": beyond the three numbers, the pupae and the adults removed 0.83 of the residual variance beyond chance (the median across five set losses), and beyond them the three numbers removed 0.004. The wording failed. It was narrowed to "as far as the level's own history does", which forbids less, and "the failure stays on record as a loss of the broader claim, not a narrowing chosen in advance". On the adults' own course a further lag removed 0.05 against the bound of a tenth: "a prediction that could fail and did not", but "a tie by construction that the field's model predicts the same way, so it shows nothing the field does not, and it is not T2 passed". The lag's sign, T2's one contrary prediction, was not decided. T2 stays conjectured, untested on a wild condition outside fisheries.

**What the explanatory reading adds, and does not.** The reading, argued, is that reading a subject as continuation relative to a class explains how it goes on. A class named for a domain can be defeated by a measurement, and T2 has this form [AI reading] ([08 §9](chapters/08-METHOD.md#what-would-defeat-the-reading)); the beetle's failure "defeats T2's class as worded in that domain, not the reading 08 §9 names, nor T2 in the fisheries". As an explanation, against a rival keeping every theorem and dropping the word, a first count gives a tie: "A tie does not make the reading false. It means the pattern explains, if it does, under either name, and the word adds nothing." What the reading adds so far is "one vocabulary, one set of questions (which relation, which class, at which grain, whether the class is constant)".

open_doubts:
B-02 is not the regulation record's concession. B-02 is item 2 of the Buddhist dossier ("理论之答正是被破之对方"). The record two-sided-regulation-and-late-reading names no review item, and neither the classical nor the Buddhist dossier has an item on 《老子》第七十七章. For the example I took the concession from three places I read. The record's Correspondence says "reading the passages as them is the AI's". Its Does-not-show says holding a level is not shown good. The passages.json entry lao-77-tian-zhi-dao classes the passage as scope and says "这一归属理论不采纳". B-02 is used in the row, not the example. Variants: the stored text and passages.json write 馀; the record and the task write 余.

Places where the homes may pull apart:
(1) 08 #open-items-ranked says "the theory's central commitments as the root of wisdom have their formal part complete (record wisdom-root-without-axiom), leaving item 7". But 03 #r-wisdom-root marks the target Open, and the wisdom-root record says the formal laws "do not by themselves prove wisdom coverage or complete the root". This is not a contradiction, but "formal part complete" could mislead a reader. Item 7 ("which law holds") is also an odd home for wisdom.
(2) 06 §六 says the per-passage table moved to history on 23 October and is no longer checked. Only passages.json is checked by verify_ro.py. I read the passages.json entry and the stored text DS01.txt line 1366, not the history chapter.
(3) The classical dossier states it was checked against commit 60d6b747f. I read the worktree at bd6c1a56d.

Scope: the "wisdom traditions" the account reads are Chinese texts and Chinese Buddhist treatises only. The wisdom-root record's evidence names limited primary readings (Aristotle, Zhuangzi, Dreyfus, Pritchard, Gettier, Tiberius), but there is no corpus of any other tradition. The row should not suggest wider coverage. GOALS.md describes the wisdom-root inquiry with a person's name, so that wording cannot go on the page.

Translation: the English of Laozi 77 is the page's own, made by AI. Nothing in the repository gives an English translation of it; the entry's reading_en paraphrases only.

Read in full: ONE-PAGE.md; THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md; GLOSSARY.md; the regulation record; the wisdom-root record's main sections; SCIENCES.md lines 1-122 and S-14 to S-16; 02 #t1 and #t2; 03 §10 and lines 466-480; 04 §3 descent and §7; 08 lines 479-640, with the T2 to T5 rows of the theses table cut at about 3,500 characters (the T2 row's UE31b evidence was read in 02 instead), and 08 lines 720-745.

Read in part: 06 lines 1-165, 369-452 and 600-650 (I did not read §五, §7.2-§十 except glossary-senses, or the conditional-laws table). Classical dossier: opening, C-31 to C-34, C-38, C-39. Buddhist dossier: lines 1-70 (opening, B-01 to B-03), with only grep hits beyond.

Not read: the history chapters CHINESE-SOURCES-AND-BECOMING.md and CIVILIZATION-THOUGHT-AND-BECOMING.md, UE31b's README beyond its anchor line, and the other SCIENCES items.
